rows.description: City Commission: four statements of work with Entech Computer Services, LLC for IT managed services and onsite staff augmentation over a three-year term, $677,522.88 total base expenditure, competitive bidding waived. Outcome not verified.

Finance Committee: Ord 2026-0867 appropriates $2,300,000 from General Fund operating reserves, including a $1,900,000 direct grant to United Way of Northeast Florida, Inc. for utility assistance; waives competitive award process; 25% advance (0.13% of general fund). Outcome not verified.
rows.shortfall: Nov 9 (Jacksonville Today): CAO Mike Weinstein: $150M to almost $200M less next budget; $300M by FY2028-29; library hours may be cut.

rows.description: Board of County Commissioners: Additional Service #9 for $42,050, funded from the Sandridge Clubhouse & Event Space account. Recipient not in feed text. Outcome not verified.
City Commission: request to use discretionary funds to support the D5K Walking Club Recruiting & Holiday Event, sponsored by Commissioner Davis. Amount not in feed text. Outcome not verified.

City Commission: approves Freeman Well Drillers, Inc. as sole source vendor for FY2026/2027 evaluation and rehabilitation of the existing 12-inch well at the Golf Club, not to exceed $150,000. Outcome not verified.

City Commission: $2,000 city sponsorship of the Greater Dania Beach Chamber of Commerce First Responders Luncheon & Holiday Toy Drive, Dec 9, 2026 at the Marriott Dania Pointe (0.002% of general fund). Outcome not verified.

Rules Committee: Ord 2026-0848 moves $30,000 from the NE FL Immigrant Resource Alliance subsidy account to a direct grant to North Florida School of Special Education, Inc. (NFSSE) for Project Tracklift; waives competitive nonprofit award process (Sec 118.107) (0.002% of general fund). Outcome not verified.
rows.shortfall: Nov 9 (Jacksonville Today): CAO Mike Weinstein: $150M to almost $200M less next budget; $300M by FY2028-29; library hours may be cut.
